design_risks_observed: the frozen eligibility rule is incompatible with the engine's dynamics: 48/48 worlds acquire a wrapping component, median at the FIRST sampled frame, and only 6/48 wrap at enrolment, so the initial-condition law is not the cause
the union enrolment convention masks the measured quantity: union residuals track the global labelled fraction while focal residuals of the SAME tracks reach 0

gates.note: after one corrective pass; the independent review returned FAIL first

independent_review.corrective_pass: single, targeted: mask re-derived from the matter ledger; element-wise relative tolerance (the AGENTS.md frozen float64 criterion); schedule bound to the committed manifest; provenance extended to the mask; contributes_to_k made a mechanical field

counter_examples.CE-1: a resealed mask channel fabricated Y=1 in a world with identically zero flows
counter_examples.CE-2: one distant 1e11 matter cell inflated a ledger-wide absolute tolerance until an erased cohort passed
counter_examples.CE-3: a blanked mask frame turned an evidence defect into a NEGATIVE scientific result
counter_examples.CE-4: --horizon was a free knob: Y=0 at 64, Y=1 at 4096 on the same law and seed

inventory_test.reading: the thresholds are NOT made unreachable by conservation; the unlabelled reserve always exceeds the component mass.  The observed cause is homogeneous mixing toward the global labelled fraction

labelled_fraction_at_enrolment.meaning: matter and cohort are BOTH exactly conserved, so this lattice-wide ratio is fixed for the whole run; under complete mixing every local residual tends to it, and every frozen convention (0.01, 0.05, 0.20) lies far below it

not_demonstrated: that Route E is false.  A verified low residual shows the instrument can respond, and the focal diagnostic shows four.  The absence of a low residual UNDER THE UNION CONVENTION is a design risk, not an impossibility

pilot.no_reroll_demonstrated: two executions produced byte-identical transport ledgers for all 48 worlds

rng.a1r5_dossier_claim_corrected: the dossier said 'every drawn value changes'; measured, about two thirds change and never by more than one unit in the last place; the real gain is that the realised grid is regular
rng.source_word: uniform on the 2**64 words of block[0:8], big-endian

sensitivity_matrix_status: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; reported whole; no cell selected; no cell produces a single Y=1 under the union tracer

union_versus_focal.computed_from: the same persisted flows; the transport is linear in the cohort, so no engine step and no second draw were needed
union_versus_focal.conclusion: the union tracer OVERESTIMATES the residual and would produce systematic false negatives; four focal components had over 99.8% of their matter replaced, two exactly complete

wrapping_onset.reading: if most worlds do NOT wrap at enrolment but ALL wrap later, the percolating component is produced by the dynamics, not by the initial-condition law
